item.title: SHEIN Distribution Corporation Recalls Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violate Mandatory Small Parts Ban
item.company: Sold Online At: US.Shein.com from November 2025 through July 2026 for about $10
item.brand: Sold Online At: US.Shein.com from November 2025 through July 2026 for about $10
item.product: Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets
item.summary: This recall involves Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets. The sets include seven toys in a variety of pastel colors and shapes. SKU “sk25070936134444119” is located on the upper right corner of a label on the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled toy sets immediately, take them away from children, and contact SHEIN for a refund. Consumers will be asked to affirm they disposed of the toy sets to receive a refund.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
